summary: T.E.R.E.S.A. iteration 6 — Frontend-only regression on BLE UX enhancements (ble.ts + connect.tsx + home.tsx). All 7 review-request checks pass on the web preview (mobile viewport 390x844). No white-screen, no page errors, no new console errors beyond the pre-existing RN-Web deprecation warnings. Seed user pm.ble@teste.com already existed; doc.teste@teste.com was (re)registered via POST /api/auth/register and login succeeds. On the Monitored Patient Home, the 'Sistema de aquecimento' card renders the gray dot + 'DESCONECTADO' label and the 'Conectar' button navigates to /connect. The Connect screen renders every expected element: status card (dot + 'Desconectado' + 'Buscar dispositivos' btn-scan + blue 'ble-not-supported' info-box with the exact 'BLE funciona apenas em builds nativos (iOS/Android)...' copy), 'Dispositivos encontrados' empty state (bluetooth-outline icon + 'Nenhum dispositivo' + TERESA01 pairing hint), new 'Diagnóstico BLE' card with the 'Limpar' link (btn-clear-diag) and the 'Os eventos BLE (scan, conexão, frames recebidos, erros) aparecerão aqui...' helper text, and the 'Passo a passo' card with all 8 numbered items (new copy). Doctor login works end-to-end: Doctor Home renders with the 'Selecionar paciente / Nenhum paciente' picker. Register screen shows the 3 role toggles (register-role-monitored/autonomous/doctor). No React Native deprecated-package issues detected; no SafeAreaView issues; no new red screens. The only console warnings observed are the carry-over RN-Web 'shadow*' / 'props.pointerEvents' deprecations already documented in iter-5.

All new UI elements correctly guarded by state (bt_off, unauthorized, reconnecting, connected). openSettings() uses expo-linking.openSettings() with a catch → toast. btn-clear-diag calls bleService.clearDiagnostics(). testIDs are complete: connect-status-card, btn-scan, btn-disconnect, btn-cancel-reconnect, btn-open-settings-bt, btn-open-settings-perm, hint-bt-off, hint-permissions, ble-not-supported, devices-card, live-tele-card, diag-card, btn-clear-diag, steps-card, status-reconnect-sub, status-last-rx. STATE_INFO covers all 8 ConnectionState variants.

/app/frontend/app/(app)/(tabs)/home.tsx:320-336 — statusMeta correctly maps all 7 relevant states to CONECTADO / CONECTANDO… / RECONECTANDO X/Y / BLUETOOTH DESLIGADO / PERMISSÃO NEGADA / DESCONECTADO. Logic for displayTemp/displayHum/treatmentState (home.tsx:315-318) unchanged — only promoted to real telemetry when `connected && telemetry`. Live 1-second ticker for 'última leitura há Xs' uses useRef+setInterval and clears on unmount.
Live verification on web preview (BLE unavailable) kept the Home card in 'DESCONECTADO' state exactly as expected, confirming the fallback path is intact.
